title: LW56e2 · parameter refinement at 0.8749570698
description: Historical parameter refinement of OpenAI’s family-003 argument to 4374785349/5000000000 = 0.8749570698. The supplied proof derives nonvanishing for all Dirichlet characters of every positive modulus, excluding the principal pole; the original development also supplies Riemann zeta and finite-order Eisenstein Hecke statements. Imported from LW56e2/quasi-riemann-improved at b83dbbd914c5751acf9bc3389cde58970437278f (8 October 2026), preserving the analytic proof and exact parameter certificates. The tracker adaptation relocates module imports, renames RH.Transport to LW56e2.Transport, and imports the pinned OpenAI sources through openai-baseline. The author reports AI-assisted development. This submission seeks tracker verification of the adapted source; it does not claim a new record or new proof discovery. Attribution and Apache-2.0 licensing are retained.
